# The Movie Database (TMDB)

> > A comprehensive, community-driven database for movies and TV shows with streaming service integration and extensive collection metadata.

TMDB is a user-editable entertainment platform that catalogs movies, TV shows, and streaming availability across services like Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney Plus, and Hulu. The database features curated collections, watchlists, and detailed metadata for media discovery.

## Platform Overview

- [The Movie Database (TMDB)](https://www.themoviedb.org/?language=ta-INlk/5889bf50c3a36819ce0033fc/ta): Homepage for TMDB, user-editable database for movies and TV shows

## Movie & TV Collections

- [Temptation of Eve](https://www.themoviedb.org/collection/712604): Collection page for OCN's Korean erotic thriller series Temptation of Eve
- [Unit 731](https://www.themoviedb.org/collection/633245): Collection of Hong Kong exploitation films about Second Sino-Japanese War
- [Akio Jissoji's Mystery File Collection](https://www.themoviedb.org/collection/1103969): Collection of mystery films by director Akio Jissoji
